dataset_name: UMAFall: Fall Detection Dataset (Universidad de Malaga)
acquisition_method: manual extraction of the official University of Malaga sensor archive
node_selection_method: per-record priority; choose first node with paired accelerometer and gyroscope streams
duplicate_timestamp_handling: preserve_distinct_sample_no_records; never deduplicate by timestamp alone
malformed_row_policy: exclude rows with non-numeric sensor-axis tokens; never repair raw files
notes: Archive is not present locally. Extracted files contain official UMAFall metadata headers. Sensor ID 0 is the RIGHTPOCKET smartphone node; IDs 1, 2, 3, and 4 are CHEST, WAIST, WRIST, and ANKLE SensorTag nodes.
